# RentFleet — ANPR marocain v2 : E2 OCR synthétique

Ce notebook entraîne et compare le recognizer officiel `arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec` sur un corpus **entièrement synthétique**, déterministe et rendu avec Noto Sans Arabic et Noto Sans sous SIL OFL 1.1. Le corpus mélange les plaques historiques arabes et le format unifié 2026 arabe + équivalent latin + `MA`. Il ne lit aucune photographie réelle, aucun checkpoint détecteur privé et aucun élément du futur holdout.

#@title 2. Récupérer les deux dépôts à des révisions exactes
REPOSITORY = 'https://github.com/getibplay-cmyk/pfe.git'
GIT_REF = 'science/moroccan-anpr-v2'
REPO_DIR = Path('/content/pfe')
PADDLEOCR_DIR = Path('/content/PaddleOCR-v3.7.0')
PADDLEOCR_TAG = 'v3.7.0'
EXPECTED_PADDLEOCR_SHA = 'b03f46425e8ff4442b268ce449e3eef758146cd4'

if not REPO_DIR.exists():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--branch', GIT_REF, '--single-branch', REPOSITORY, str(REPO_DIR)], check=True)
else:
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'fetch', 'origin', GIT_REF], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'checkout', '--force', GIT_REF], check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'reset', '--hard', f'origin/{GIT_REF}'], check=True)
GIT_SHA = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()

if not PADDLEOCR_DIR.exists():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', '--branch', PADDLEOCR_TAG, '--single-branch', 'https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR.git', str(PADDLEOCR_DIR)], check=True)
PADDLEOCR_SHA = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(PADDLEOCR_DIR), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
assert PADDLEOCR_SHA == EXPECTED_PADDLEOCR_SHA, (PADDLEOCR_SHA, EXPECTED_PADDLEOCR_SHA)
print({'git_ref': GIT_REF, 'git_sha': GIT_SHA, 'paddleocr_tag': PADDLEOCR_TAG, 'paddleocr_sha': PADDLEOCR_SHA})

#@title 3. Installer PaddlePaddle GPU et PaddleOCR dans un venv isolé
cuda_version = str(torch.version.cuda or '')
if cuda_version.startswith('11.'):
    paddle_index = 'https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/packages/stable/cu118/'
elif cuda_version.startswith('12.'):
    paddle_index = 'https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/packages/stable/cu126/'
else:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Génération CUDA Colab non prise en charge: {cuda_version!r}')
OCR_VENV = Path('/content/venvs/rentfleet-paddleocr-e2-v1')
OCR_PYTHON = OCR_VENV / 'bin/python'
OCR_VENV.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check', 'jedi==0.19.2', 'virtualenv==20.35.4'], check=True)
if not OCR_PYTHON.is_file():
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'virtualenv', str(OCR_VENV)], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(OCR_PYTHON), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check', 'paddlepaddle-gpu==3.3.0', '--index-url', paddle_index], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(OCR_PYTHON), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check', '--requirement', str(PADDLEOCR_DIR / 'requirements.txt')], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(OCR_PYTHON), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check', '--requirement', str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/requirements-vehicle-plate-colab.txt')], check=True)
subprocess.run([str(OCR_PYTHON), '-m', 'pip', 'check'], check=True)
verification_code = '''
import json, paddle, paddleocr
paddle.utils.run_check()
assert paddle.is_compiled_with_cuda() and paddle.device.cuda.device_count() >= 1
print(json.dumps({'paddle': paddle.__version__, 'paddleocr': paddleocr.__version__, 'paddle_gpu_count': paddle.device.cuda.device_count()}))
'''
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment['PADDLE_PDX_MODEL_SOURCE'] = 'BOS'
subprocess.run([str(OCR_PYTHON), '-c', verification_code], check=True, env=environment)
print({'wheel_index': paddle_index, 'ocr_python': str(OCR_PYTHON), 'isolated': True})

#@title 4. Télécharger et vérifier les entrées officielles E2
ASSET_DIR = Path('/content/anpr_e2_assets')
ASSET_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
FONT_ARCHIVE = ASSET_DIR / 'NotoSansArabic-v2.013.zip'
FONT_ARCHIVE_URL = 'https://github.com/notofonts/arabic/releases/download/NotoSansArabic-v2.013/NotoSansArabic-v2.013.zip'
FONT_ARCHIVE_SHA256 = '1301aceaea84c501cf2e6dcfb3182e2328c8eae5725817fcb239672bda7154f1'
FONT_DIR = ASSET_DIR / 'noto-arabic-v2.013'
FONT_PATH = FONT_DIR / 'NotoSansArabic-SemiBold.ttf'
FONT_LICENSE = FONT_DIR / 'OFL.txt'
LATIN_FONT_PATH = ASSET_DIR / 'NotoSans-wdth-wght.ttf'
LATIN_FONT_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/6a003b5eb672dc8bf5bff5937cf5863f8b175445/ofl/notosans/NotoSans%5Bwdth%2Cwght%5D.ttf'
LATIN_FONT_SHA256 = 'bfb7bb691513f12e734dc346c03a03f784912432d7e3fa8e56efcf906fe86b3d'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE = ASSET_DIR / 'OFL-NotoSans.txt'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_URL = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/6a003b5eb672dc8bf5bff5937cf5863f8b175445/ofl/notosans/OFL.txt'
LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_SHA256 = 'cee9892f9f0cc8fe882c9e9537ee6a89621d86ee7ceaf70b02e2b2b1c25c061a'
PRETRAINED_PARAMS = ASSET_DIR / 'arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_pretrained.pdparams'
PRETRAINED_URL = 'https://paddle-model-ecology.bj.bcebos.com/paddlex/official_pretrained_model/arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_pretrained.pdparams'

def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()

if not FONT_ARCHIVE.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(FONT_ARCHIVE_URL, FONT_ARCHIVE)
assert sha256(FONT_ARCHIVE) == FONT_ARCHIVE_SHA256
if not FONT_PATH.is_file() or not FONT_LICENSE.is_file():
    FONT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(FONT_ARCHIVE) as archive:
        FONT_PATH.write_bytes(archive.read('NotoSansArabic/hinted/ttf/NotoSansArabic-SemiBold.ttf'))
        FONT_LICENSE.write_bytes(archive.read('OFL.txt'))
if not LATIN_FONT_PATH.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(LATIN_FONT_URL, LATIN_FONT_PATH)
if not LATIN_FONT_LICENSE.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_URL, LATIN_FONT_LICENSE)
assert sha256(LATIN_FONT_PATH) == LATIN_FONT_SHA256
assert sha256(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE) == LATIN_FONT_LICENSE_SHA256
if not PRETRAINED_PARAMS.is_file():
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(PRETRAINED_URL, PRETRAINED_PARAMS)
assert PRETRAINED_PARAMS.stat().st_size > 1_000_000
OFFICIAL_CONFIG = PADDLEOCR_DIR / 'configs/rec/PP-OCRv5/multi_language/arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec.yaml'
OFFICIAL_DICTIONARY = PADDLEOCR_DIR / 'ppocr/utils/dict/ppocrv5_arabic_dict.txt'
dictionary = OFFICIAL_DICTIONARY.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
assert len(dictionary) == 747
assert set('0123456789MAABDHETYKLMNCFRSأبدهوطيكلمنصفرس').issubset(set(dictionary))
print({'font_archive_sha256': sha256(FONT_ARCHIVE), 'arabic_font_sha256': sha256(FONT_PATH), 'latin_font_sha256': sha256(LATIN_FONT_PATH), 'latin_font_license_sha256': sha256(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE), 'official_pretrained_sha256': sha256(PRETRAINED_PARAMS), 'official_config_sha256': sha256(OFFICIAL_CONFIG), 'official_dictionary_sha256': sha256(OFFICIAL_DICTIONARY), 'dictionary_characters': len(dictionary)})

#@title 5. Générer le corpus synthétique local sans split test
DATASET_DIR = Path('/content/anpr_e2_synthetic_dataset')
assert not DATASET_DIR.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {DATASET_DIR}'
generate_command = [
    str(OCR_PYTHON), str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/generate_synthetic_dataset.py'),
    '--font', str(FONT_PATH), '--font-license', str(FONT_LICENSE),
    '--latin-font', str(LATIN_FONT_PATH), '--latin-font-license', str(LATIN_FONT_LICENSE),
    '--output-dir', str(DATASET_DIR), '--seed', str(SEED),
    '--train-groups', str(TRAIN_GROUPS),
    '--validation-groups', str(VALIDATION_GROUPS),
    '--calibration-groups', str(CALIBRATION_GROUPS),
    '--variants-per-group', str(VARIANTS_PER_GROUP),
    '--unified-fraction', str(UNIFIED_FRACTION),
]
subprocess.run(generate_command, cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True, env=environment)
generation = json.loads((DATASET_DIR / 'generation_report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert generation['qualification_claim'] is False
assert generation['final_test_opened'] is False
assert generation['contains_real_vehicle_data'] is False
assert set(generation['configuration']['group_counts']) == {'train', 'validation', 'calibration'}
assert set(generation['configuration']['format_group_counts']) == {'legacy_arabic', 'unified_2026_arabic_latin'}
print({'groups': generation['artifacts']['groups'], 'images': generation['artifacts']['images'], 'formats': generation['configuration']['format_group_counts'], 'manifest_sha256': generation['artifacts']['manifest_sha256'], 'dataset_images_sha256': generation['artifacts']['dataset_images_sha256'], 'test_rows': 0})

#@title 6. Exécuter E2 : baseline, fine-tuning et sélection validation
LOCAL_OUTPUT = Path('/content/anpr_e2_synthetic_run')
assert not LOCAL_OUTPUT.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {LOCAL_OUTPUT}'
e2_command = [
    str(OCR_PYTHON), str(REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/vehicle_plate/e2_synthetic.py'),
    '--python', str(OCR_PYTHON), '--paddleocr-dir', str(PADDLEOCR_DIR),
    '--dataset-dir', str(DATASET_DIR), '--output-dir', str(LOCAL_OUTPUT),
    '--pretrained-prefix', str(PRETRAINED_PARAMS.with_suffix('')),
    '--repository-sha', GIT_SHA, '--paddleocr-sha', PADDLEOCR_SHA,
    '--epochs', str(EPOCHS), '--batch-size', str(BATCH_SIZE), '--seed', str(SEED),
]
subprocess.run(e2_command, cwd=REPO_DIR, check=True, env=environment)
report = json.loads((LOCAL_OUTPUT / 'E2_SYNTHETIC_COMPLETE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert report['status'] == 'synthetic_e2_complete_not_qualified'
assert report['synthetic_only'] is True and report['final_test_opened'] is False
assert report['qualification_claim'] is False and report['saas_integration_allowed'] is False
print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'metrics': report['metrics'], 'selection': report['selection'], 'final_test_opened': report['final_test_opened'], 'qualification_claim': report['qualification_claim']}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

#@title 7. Vérifier les empreintes puis publier les artefacts dans le Drive privé
def verify_bundle(root):
    lines = (Path(root) / 'SHA256SUMS').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    assert lines
    for line in lines:
        expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
        target = Path(root) / relative
        assert target.is_file(), target
        assert sha256(target) == expected, relative
    return len(lines)

local_files = verify_bundle(LOCAL_OUTPUT)
assert not DRIVE_OUTPUT.exists(), f'Aucun écrasement autorisé: {DRIVE_OUTPUT}'
DRIVE_OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(LOCAL_OUTPUT, DRIVE_OUTPUT)
drive_files = verify_bundle(DRIVE_OUTPUT)
assert drive_files == local_files
drive_report = json.loads((DRIVE_OUTPUT / 'E2_SYNTHETIC_COMPLETE.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert drive_report == report
print({'status': drive_report['status'], 'verified_files': drive_files, 'drive_output': str(DRIVE_OUTPUT), 'synthetic_only': True, 'final_test_opened': False, 'saas_integration_allowed': False})

## Interprétation obligatoire

Le dossier Drive est une preuve de mécanique E2 synthétique et de reproductibilité, pas une qualification ANPR. Le modèle sélectionné ne peut être branché au SaaS. En inférence, une image véhicule doit d'abord passer par le détecteur de plaque ; appliquer l'OCR à toute l'image est interdit. L'étape suivante exige des données réelles licenciées/consenties séparées du futur holdout, puis le gate final préenregistré reste à exécuter une seule fois.
